headline: Youth development officer exam postponed amid question leak allegations
summary: Job seekers blocked major roads in Dhaka after the recruitment test for assistant upazila youth development officers was cancelled at the last minute.
details: A recruitment exam for the post of assistant upazila youth development officer was postponed at the last minute today after examinees alleged that the question paper had been leaked.
The exam was scheduled to be held at 95 centres across Dhaka, but was postponed at the eleventh hour for what officials called "unavoidable reasons".
Agitated examinees took to the streets, blocking Manik Mia Avenue, Shahbagh, and Satmasjid Road in Dhaka, while demonstrations were held at Shapla Chattar in Motijheel.
Protesters claimed that the question paper had been leaked an hour before the exam was set to start and demanded that the authorities reschedule the test as soon as possible.
Dhaka Metropolitan Police reported that protesters blocked Manik Mia Avenue around noon, causing significant traffic disruption before the road was cleared around 12:50 pm.
caption:
Exam cancelled at the last minute! Job seekers block Dhaka roads over alleged question leak.

A recruitment exam for the post of assistant upazila youth development officer was postponed at the last minute today after examinees alleged that the question paper had been leaked.

The exam was scheduled to be held at 95 centres across Dhaka, but was postponed at the eleventh hour for what officials called "unavoidable reasons".

Agitated examinees took to the streets, blocking Manik Mia Avenue, Shahbagh, and Satmasjid Road in Dhaka, while demonstrations were held at Shapla Chattar in Motijheel.

Protesters claimed that the question paper had been leaked an hour before the exam was set to start and demanded that the authorities reschedule the test as soon as possible.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police reported that protesters blocked Manik Mia Avenue around noon, causing significant traffic disruption before the road was cleared around 12:50 pm.

headline: Two crude bombs thrown outside Prime Minister’s Office in Dhaka
summary: Two suspects on a motorcycle hurled the devices late Saturday; one exploded while the other was defused by the bomb disposal unit.
details: Two crude bombs were thrown outside the Prime Minister's Office in Dhaka's Tejgaon area during a late-night incident on Saturday.
According to Ibne Mizan, deputy commissioner of police for the Tejgaon Division, the attack occurred around 1:30 am.
Police report that two individuals on a motorcycle arrived at the scene, waited for a few minutes, and then hurled the devices before fleeing.
One of the crude bombs exploded upon impact, while the other remained unexploded.
The Dhaka Metropolitan Police's bomb disposal unit rushed to the scene and successfully defused the second bomb.
The suspects are believed to have fled towards Mirpur Road via Agargaon.
Police are currently analyzing CCTV footage from nearby cameras to identify and track down those involved in the attack.
caption:
Two crude bombs hurled at the Prime Minister's Office at 1:30 am. One exploded, the other was defused.

Two crude bombs were thrown outside the Prime Minister's Office in Dhaka's Tejgaon area during a late-night incident on Saturday.

According to Ibne Mizan, deputy commissioner of police for the Tejgaon Division, the attack occurred around 1:30 am.

Police report that two individuals on a motorcycle arrived at the scene, waited for a few minutes, and then hurled the devices before fleeing.

One of the crude bombs exploded upon impact, while the other remained unexploded.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police's bomb disposal unit rushed to the scene and successfully defused the second bomb.

The suspects are believed to have fled towards Mirpur Road via Agargaon.

Police are currently analyzing CCTV footage from nearby cameras to identify and track down those involved in the attack.
